# Tailrocks: Simplify Apply

`tailrocks-simplify` — part of [tailrocks-skills](../../README.md) · [documentation](https://skills.tailrocks.com/docs/skills/tailrocks-simplify)

Apply one explicitly approved set of measured code removals within a bound diff while preserving every observable behavior. Requires a proven oracle; never discovers removals or changes behavior.

## Invocation

This skill never activates on its own. Name it in your request:

> Use `tailrocks-simplify` …

Arguments: `apply <approved removal set and PR, branch, or diff>`
